exclusions: The file is already the prepared dataset: its 'excluded' column is 0 for every row, i.e. the a priori exclusions were applied upstream (n.excl gives the per-site count removed). Rows with a missing likelihood rating are marked invalid. Only the 'b.similar' group (U Penn, UCB, UVA, Stanford) is loaded, the 'similar U.S. university sites' population the package materials target; the MTurk ('a.mturk') and 'c.dissimilar' groups are left out so the pooled estimate matches one reported analysis.
